description: Preserve approved math sources and prevent currency, LaTeX, generated-data, and release-artifact drift.

defaultPrompt: Find and fix the KaTeX errors in this math content.
Check whether dollar signs are being misread as math.
Verify this build cannot reintroduce raw LaTeX or broken formulas.
interface.longDescription: Find and fix KaTeX and LaTeX rendering errors in math content. Distinguish currency such as $5 from math such as $x+2$, repair broken delimiters or malformed formulas, and verify source data, builds, and learner pages so the same error does not return after deployment.

name: math-content-integrity
